title: A task scheduler with priorities
description:
Simulate a scheduler that runs tasks by priority and deadline.

```
t=0  run "fix crash" (priority 1)
t=5  run "reply email" (priority 2)
t=6  "backup" missed its deadline (t=5)
t=9  run "write report" (priority 3)
3 done, 1 missed
```
hints: `Reverse((priority, sequence, name))` orders by priority, then by when it was added (lesson 8.03).
Move tasks from the arrival queue into the heap whenever the clock passes their arrival time.
requirements: Tasks with a priority, a duration and an optional deadline, in a `BinaryHeap` with `Reverse` for the smallest priority first.
A `VecDeque` of tasks waiting to arrive at later times; a `BTreeMap` of finished tasks by time.
Ties broken by the order tasks were added (put a counter in the heap's tuple).
stretch: Add task dependencies and only start a task when everything it depends on is done.
